subject: Micro-Pilot: request for two-week runway + surge cushion
messages:
From: Samantha Park <samantha@clearbridge.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Micro-pilot plans — short runway ask

Hi Laura,

Quick question from our side: we’re hitting the tail end of the 30-day micro-pilot and expect a spike in RTL inference this coming week because of an internal demo. Is Redwood open to either (A) a two-week runway extension, or (B) a small short-term surge add-on we can purchase for one week to absorb the demo traffic?

We want to avoid throttling the demo but aren’t sure the longer-term consumption will sustain a larger committed band. If there’s a simple pricing option (credits or fixed surge fee) that we can sign quickly, we’ll take it.

Can you send a short proposal? Tom (VP of Product) is cc’d — he’s leading the demo.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Park
Head of ML Ops
Clearbridge AI

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Micro-pilot plans — short runway ask

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up, and for looping Tom in.

We can do both paths. High-level options below — happy to finalize whichever you prefer and send an abbreviated SOW + DocuSign link. I’ve included Ben (pricing) and Dev (legal) to make this fast.

Option A — Two-week extension
- Additional 14 calendar days appended to the current pilot start date.
- We’ll support the same throughput window and preserve existing quantization/latency settings.
- Pricing: we can issue a 20% credit on the incremental token spend for those 14 days (applied as account credit).
- No additional SLA changes.

Option B — One-week surge add-on
- One-week temporary surge pool (isolated capacity) sized for the demo window.
- Pricing: a fixed surge fee of $9,500 for the week or, alternatively, $7,000 + $0.04/token overage if you prefer usage-aligned economics.
- Includes priority routing and elevated concurrency limits for the week.

We’ve attached a quick usage estimate to show where the economics land (usage-estimates.xlsx) and a draft SOW for the short addendum (SOW-draft-v2.pdf).

If you want to move faster, I can put together a single-line SOW (one page) that Tom can sign in DocuSign today.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: usage-estimates.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Micro-pilot plans — short runway ask

Looping in quick pricing thoughts. I’m okay with giving a modest concession to close; two practical approaches:

1) If they want runway: make it a 14-day extension with a 15–20% credit on incremental usage. 20% buys goodwill and is still light on revenue impact for such a small window.

2) If they want surge: prefer the fixed-fee route (predictable cost) but offer a $1,500 discount if they accept the DocuSign within 24 hours. That gets us commitment and pushes time pressure.

Also, confirm that the surge pool will be billed as a separate line item and not eat into current committed capacity buckets. Dev — can you flag any legal concerns for a 14-day amendment?

Ben
Head of Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Park <samantha@clearbridge.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@clearbridge.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Micro-pilot plans — short runway ask

Appreciate the options, Laura and Ben. For our demo cadence, Option A (two-week extension) is preferred because it preserves our current test harness without a hard cutover. However, we also want a small cushion in case the demo drives unexpected bursts.

Proposal from our side: approve the 14-day extension at 20% credit, plus add a capped surge bucket for demo days only: $5k cap on surge consumption (Redwood to provide priority routing). If you can provide a 1-page SOW and the DocuSign link, Tom will sign today.

Samantha

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@clearbridge.ai>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Micro-pilot plans — short runway ask

Thanks — that works. I’ve updated the SOW to reflect: 14-day extension, 20% credit on incremental usage during the extension, and a capped demo surge of $5,000 (priority routing and temporary concurrency bump).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/sign/ABC123
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/CB-9987

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (updated) — single-page addendum
Attachment: usage-estimates.xlsx

If Tom can sign by EOD tomorrow we’ll schedule a brief implementation handoff (30 min) with our infra team the following morning.

—Laura
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@clearbridge.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Park <samantha@clearbridge.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Micro-pilot plans — short runway ask

Signed via DocuSign (link worked). Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please schedule the 30-minute infra handoff Monday 09:30 PT and confirm the priority routing is enabled starting Sunday 06:00 PT for our demo window.

Tom Reynolds
VP Product, Clearbridge AI
